name: Should I choose a prefabricated acrylic surround or custom tile for my new shower?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a prefabricated acrylic surround or custom tile for my new shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Acrylic shower surrounds install quickly, require zero grout maintenance, and have a lower initial cost, but they offer limited design flexibility and fixed sizing. Custom tile allows complete design personalization, fits irregular alcove dimensions, and accommodates built-in stone benches, custom niches, and decorative accents. However, tile requires a longer installation process, meticulous waterproofing behind the walls, and routine grout cleaning. If your bathroom has non-standard dimensions or you prefer durable, high-end materials like marble or porcelain, custom tile is usually the better investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acrylic is fast to install and low maintenance, while custom tile offers greater design flexibility, fits unique alcove sizes, and provides higher long-term aesthetic value.
